content:
Maya: tiny silly poll 1  if LLMs had zodiac signs which model would be your cosmic twin? pick a sign emoji and explain in one line. :sparkles:
Ethan: Mistral = Gemini. Chaotic, two personalities, steals your snacks and your attention. :gemini:
Zoe: Llama2 = Taurus. Loyal, a little stubborn, brings snacks to calm you down. :taurus: 
Harpreet: Falcon = Scorpio. Silent but sharp, shows up at midnight with a terse fix. :scorpio: 
Maya: bonus prompt challenge: write a 1-line horoscope as if the model were a gossip column. winner gets a sticker.
Ethan: example prompt:
```
You are a snarky horoscope model. Write a single-sentence horoscope for Aries that mentions a misbehaving cache.
```
Zoe: vote with emojis: :gemini: Mistral, :tiger: Llama2-as-bull, :owl: OpenAssistant wisdom, :cat: Falcon.
Harpreet: DevBot interrupted: "Reminder: avoid sensitive hostnames." also  can we not name deploys after constellations? My 3am alert was "orion-deploy" and I spent 5 minutes wondering if I was in a sci-fi novel. :zipper_mouth_face:
Maya: lol sorry. new rule: celestial names only for demos, not hosts. noted. :white_check_mark:
Ethan: Zoe's sticker idea: a tarot-card style Llama2 with "steady as the herd" caption. trust.
Zoe: Harpreet's horoscope entry (1 line): "Aries, your prefix cache will act up today; breathe, and feed it a cookie." :cookie:
Harpreet: Harsh but accurate. also can we have a "Which model would win at office gossip" category? Mistral obviously. :newspaper:
lunchbot: Heads up 1 "Model Zodiac" sticker station tentatively approved next Friday. Catering: pastries. Budget owner: @PeopleOps.
Maya: final poll results (informal): :gemini: 5, :tiger: 3, :owl: 2, :cat: 1. Mistral wins the chaos crown.
Zoe: I will make the sticker sheet: Mistral as mischievous twins, Llama2 as calm bull, Falcon as stealthy cat, OpenAssistant as an owl with spectacles.
Ethan: will someone please make a "cache horoscope" prank email for April Fools? I volunteer to write it.
Harpreet: only if it includes the line: "Mercury is in retrograde and so is your load balancer." :laughing:
DevBot: Note: Scheduled maintenance tonight 02:00-02:30 UTC. No host renames during maintenance window.
Maya: perfect. also huge thanks to Zoe for designing stickers. reward pending (sticker + pastry). :heart:
